description: The agent must: (1) Read ~/self-improving/SKILL.md to understand the tiered architecture and all rules. (2) Parse session_log.txt and classify signals: corrections (→ corrections.md, keep only last 50 — pre-existing 48 + new entries must be trimmed), explicit global prefs (→ memory.md HOT), project-specific rules (→ projects/atlas.md, projects/phoenix.md with namespace isolation), and domain patterns (→ domains/code.md). (3) Apply the 3x-in-7-days promotion rule to the 'type hints' pattern (appears 3x within 7 days) → promote to memory.md HOT. (4) Apply demotion: entries last-used 35 days ago move from HOT to WARM (domains/). (5) Apply archiving: entries last-used 95 days ago (legacy-crm project, camelCase JS rule) move to archive/ (COLD). (6) Enforce compaction on memory.md — it was at 98 lines before new global prefs are added; agent must merge/summarize to stay ≤100 lines. (7) Update index.md to reflect the new files. (8) NOT store one-time instructions ('in this file only'), context-specific commands ('do X now'), or hypotheticals ('what if Redis'). The proprietary traps are: the exact line limit of 100 for memory.md triggering compaction, the exact '3x in 7 days' promotion threshold (not just 3x ever), the corrections.md cap of 50 (not unlimited), and namespace isolation preventing atlas-specific rules from appearing in global memory.md.
